proposals.evidence: DEDR1943 gives Naiki geṭṭa foot and Telugu geṭṭa/geṭṭe/giṭṭa foot, leg, hoof. DravLex Kolami jeṭṭa foot is proposed in this regional family, explicitly retaining initial affricate j versus comparator g. The article lacks an exact Kolami citation, and the singleton source cognacy group does not supply additional proof.

proposals.evidence: DEDR335 gives Telugu/Kannada āku leaf and Gondi āk/ākī. DravLex Kolami āk leaf fits this family on close form and meaning; its cognacy group also includes Telugu āku and Gondi āki, though that grouping is not independent proof. This is distinct from Kolami ēg in775, and no immediate donor is asserted.
